name: Jahid Hasan Rony
title: Lecturer, Researcher
subtitle: BSc, MSc in CSE, DUET
bio:
I am a postgraduate researcher in Computer Science and Engineering, interested in advancing how artificial intelligence can understand visual information efficiently.

My research focuses on deep learning and computer vision, particularly semantic segmentation and lightweight model design. I completed my B.Sc. (2023) and M.Sc. (2026) at Dhaka University of Engineering & Technology (DUET), Gazipur, Bangladesh, where my master’s research focused on developing efficient segmentation models for visual analysis (published in Nature, Scientific Reports). Previously, I worked as a Research Assistant at Independent University, Bangladesh, contributing to research in medical imaging, UAV-based image analysis, and deep learning-based segmentation. I also enjoy teaching and communicating complex technical concepts in a clear and accessible manner.

Currently, I am looking for Ph.D. opportunities to further develop as an independent researcher, contribute to meaningful research, and advance efficient and practical AI methods for visual understanding.
